text: Imagine the money a country earns sitting in three pockets
zh: 想象一个国家挣到的钱放在三个口袋里

text: one for households one for companies and one for the government
zh: 一个给家庭，一个给企业，一个给政府

text: how it moves between them decides what people can actually buy
zh: 钱在它们之间怎么流动，决定了人们实际能买多少东西

text: and that is where the story of fiscal rebalancing begins
zh: 财政再平衡的故事就从这里开始
